svg.aria-label: Bar chart of the table below: how many times faster oneyaml-csharp is than the strongest competitor on each task, log scale, higher is better. 7 tasks: 5 better, 0 level, 1 mixed, 0 worse, 1 not comparable. Speeds are over real-world workloads. A mark counts every workload. Loses only outside the real-world workloads: unchanged emit.
svg.title: oneyaml-csharp: speed per task against the strongest competitor
svg.desc: oneyaml-csharp: speed per task against the strongest competitor. Times faster than the strongest competitor on each task (geometric mean over its real-world workloads), log scale: bars to the right are faster, higher is better, bars to the left are slower. The mark beside a bar counts every workload of the task, generated and reference ones included. Unchanged emit times the write path of a document that was not edited; a library that keeps the text returns it without rendering, so it is not a rendering speed. A † marks a cell measured differently from the task as specified. typed load 1.28× faster win (ours 47.5 µs vs 60.7 µs; workloads: 5 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 5; the speed is over the 1 real-world workloads and the mark counts all 5); generic load 1.33× faster win (ours 22.2 µs vs 29.5 µs; workloads: 31 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 31; the speed is over the 7 real-world workloads and the mark counts all 31); dump 2.63× faster win (ours 4.77 µs vs 12.6 µs; workloads: 28 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 28; the speed is over the 6 real-world workloads and the mark counts all 28); document parse 10.8× faster win (ours 17.8 µs vs 193 µs; workloads: 29 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 29; the speed is over the 7 real-world workloads and the mark counts all 29); unchanged emit (write-back of an unedited document; not a rendering speed) 2.48× faster mixed (ours 504 ns vs 1.25 µs; workloads: 26 better, 1 level, 2 worse of 29; the speed is over the 7 real-world workloads and the mark counts all 29, loses 2 of 20 generated workloads); edit script 74.0× faster win (ours 7.48 µs vs 554 µs; workloads: 21 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 21; the speed is over the 6 real-world workloads and the mark counts all 21); patch (RFC 6902) no rival.
